findings.explanation: HOL4 defines THE by new_recursive_definition with the single clause THE (SOME x) = x. THE_DEF and the other saved option theorems say nothing about THE NONE. The Lean definition makes THE none = ARB hold by rfl, for every type. It thereby identifies THE NONE with the HOL4 constant ARB, and with every other Lean constant defined as ARB outside its specification. HOL4 leaves the equation THE NONE = ARB open.
findings.repair:
opaque THE_NONE {α : Type} [h : Nonempty α] : α := Classical.choice h

def THE {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : Option α → α
  | some x => x
  | none => THE_NONE
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.Core

open CmlTS

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : THE (none : Option α) = ARB := rfl

findings.explanation: HOL4 specifies @ only by SELECT_AX (P x ==> P ($@ P)), and ARB is a new_constant with no definition (boolScript.sml:245). So (@x. F) = ARB is open. In Lean, select is the transparent Classical.epsilon, whose no-witness branch is Classical.choice, and ARB (Core.lean:7) is the transparent Classical.choice. Lean therefore proves select P = ARB for every unsatisfiable P, at every type. This reaches clients, for example sqrt of a negative real and select-based cardinality of an infinite set.
findings.repair:
opaque ARB {α : Type} [h : Nonempty α] : α := Classical.choice h

opaque selectSpec {α : Type} [h : Nonempty α] (P : α → Prop) : {x : α // (∃ y, P y) → P x} := Classical.strongIndefiniteDescription P h

def select {α : Type} [Nonempty α] (P : α → Prop) : α := (selectSpec P).val
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.Core

open CmlTS

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : select (fun _ : α => False) = ARB := by
  have h : ¬ ∃ x : α, False := fun ⟨_, hx⟩ => hx
  first
    | (simp [select, ARB, Classical.epsilon, Classical.strongIndefiniteDescription]; done)
    | (unfold select ARB Classical.epsilon Classical.strongIndefiniteDescription; rw [dif_neg h]; done)
    | (unfold select ARB Classical.epsilon Classical.strongIndefiniteDescription; rw [dif_neg h]; rfl)
    | (unfold select ARB Classical.epsilon Classical.strongIndefiniteDescription; split <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; simp_all))
